academicJudgment.decision: Remain unresolved. The foundational themes and graduate outcomes do not settle the advanced chosen-perspective content and integration. Excluding all unknown advanced formation leaves preparatory thematic correspondence rather than an established stable bachelor academic core. The minor30EC is genuine choice space and supplies no confirmed advanced health core. Missing detailed thesis rules alone would not force deferral; the material advanced academic weighting does.

courseReview.status: Two unapproved feasible24course180ECresearch challenges,12differentcourses90ECeach, not final accepted alternative count. First integrates epidemiology/healthpsychology/physiology/disease and methods; second introduces actual environment/risk/remediation/governance with explicit health strand.
courseReview.strengths: Dedicated epidemiology includes disease measures/designs/bias/confounding, prevention and local health-needs/intervention evidence. MedicalHealthPsychology studies biopsychosocial health, inequalities, behaviour change, clinical cases/interviewing. Physiology, immunology and pathology sustain biological understanding; actual methods include regression, multivariable health/behavioural analysis and qualitative interviewing/coding.
courseReview.limits: Partner-defined delta research guarantees no health topic. Persuasion and ClimateCommunication projects are not assured health interventions. Chemical/materials gateways, recycling and geochemistry are environmental context, not health-care-system design or clinical training. PublicEconomics covers health funding as one domain, not a complete health-economics sequence. General Ethics does not establish a new named Maastricht philosophy module. Four absent outlines remain description-only; no invented detail.
courseReview.progression: Biomedical/behaviour gateways precede physiology/disease/healthpsychology; statistical and social foundations precede experimental methods; sustainabilityIthenIIprecede recycling/renewable work. All actual hard constraints checked afresh; no advisory gateway turned into new prerequisite.
